newsitem.title: USA: Everen cuts Amylin on Phase III trial data.
newsitem.headline: Everen cuts Amylin on Phase III trial data.

text.p: Everen Securities said analyst Albert Rauch had cut his short-term rating on Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc to underperform from outperform, citing disappointing Phase III results of pramlintide, its candidate drug for diabetes.
-- said cut long-term rating to perform from outperform.

-- said Phase III results released after the market closed Friday suggested pramlintide had a "minor affect on glycated hemoglobin levels in type I diabetes and no effect on glycated hemoglobin levels in type II diabetes."
-- said results also indicated pramlintide "has a minor positive impact on weight and cholesterol."
-- said it does not believe results justify the use of pramlintide in type II diabetes, adding it expects the drug's penetration into the type I diabetic population will be low.
-- Amylin fell 6-3/8 to 8-1/2 in morning trading.
